kjv: Who maketh his (Yahweh's) angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire
mine: he (Yahweh) makes the winds his messengers, flaming fire his ministers
note: in a hymn about weather (vv.3-4 clouds, wind) the natural sense is that God uses winds as his messengers and fire as his servants; the KJV reverses subject and object ("makes angels into spirits"), as Heb 1:7 reads the LXX.

mine: the rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers
note: shefannim are rock hyraxes (Procavia), small mammals of rocky slopes; "conies" (rabbits) is an English approximation (also Lev 11:5, Prov 30:26).
